summary: Adds a bounded offline thread protocol, deterministic source targets, and revision-segment binding for agent-to-human report handoff.

evidence.sourceGrammar: Version-3 review JSON is a strict closed record with bounded subject threads and ordered revision segments; each segment owns its report revision, target, optional exact selected-text start/end target references with Unicode code-point offsets and NFC quote, ordered user/agent messages, and resolved state. Valid version-2 whole-block records normalize losslessly. Compile-time targets come only from parsed container directives and ordinary Markdown blocks, with authored ranges and optional explicit section identity.
evidence.executionCapabilities: The package-owned reader runtime maps valid native text ranges to deterministic anchors, reuses the thread editor and current-note list, stores session state in memory, validates exact local imports against reconstructed DOM ranges, and downloads every block thread and selection note in one canonical JSON file; it cannot rewrite Markdown, execute messages, register callbacks, sync a network account, or grant verified authority.
evidence.confinement: Review inspection first prepares the report source root, then resolves the relative review path through the existing URI-normalized lexical and canonical symlink confinement boundary before reading one ordinary bounded file.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Build, embedded target discovery, review parsing, and source binding use local source files and package code only; both output formats retain normal file URL behavior and the review command starts no listener or network request.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: Canonical version-3 serialization omits clocks and random values, sorts thread identities while preserving segment/message order, normalizes human text to Unicode NFC, distinguishes whole-block and exact range subjects, and is byte-equal for equivalent state; report revision separately binds the unchanged version-2 canonical target projection.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: The target manifest is escaped inert template text; package-owned controls use text/value DOM APIs, File text parsing, and a revoked local Blob object URL. No author script, innerHTML, storage, network, form submission, or new CSP source is added.
evidence.accessibility: Normal mode exposes only the labelled Review entry until a valid selection reveals a native localized Create note button beside the highlight; Shift release focuses it for the keyboard route. Target and note controls are native buttons; fields and alerts are labelled; desktop remains non-modal; mobile uses native modal focus containment; Close and Exit return focus and remove hidden controls from navigation.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: Sidecar parsing and binding are bounded preparation work; browser initialization remains one manifest/prior-state pass with no scroll-time scan. Runtime and stylesheet byte budgets are enforced by unit and package checks.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No package or browser dependency is added; implementation uses existing Node crypto/filesystem APIs, unified traversal, React escaping, and the MIT-licensed package code already distributed by the project.
evidence.compatibility: Existing Markdown, whole-block threads, build, validate, inspect, unchanged version-2 target manifests/report revisions, single-file and directory contracts remain supported; version-2 review artifacts without selection data are accepted, unsupported or disguised wider schema versions fail explicitly, and endpoint binding cannot impersonate changed content in a still-present source file.
